name: matanolabs/matano
description: Matano is an open-source, serverless security data lake platform built on AWS that normalizes and stores security logs from 50+ sources using Apache Iceberg with ECS schemas. It enables threat hunting and detection through Python-based rules with full data ownership.
score_rationale: Innovative cloud-native security data lake with 1.7k stars, filling a gap for organizations needing scalable open-source SIEM alternatives on AWS.
